name: @dekimuhq/business-json
description: business.json — a verifiable business identity at /.well-known/business.json, bound to a qualified-certificate signature and a DNS record. Parse, validate, and check bindings.
author: Dekimu

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:no-private-dep && npm run build && npm run check:pinned-default && npm run gen:schema && npm run typecheck:tests && npm test
scripts.check:pinned-default: node --input-type=module -e "import('./dist/cli.js').then(m=>{if(!m.DEFAULT_VERIFIER_KEYS.length){console.error('FAIL: DEFAULT_VERIFIER_KEYS is empty — pin verify.dekimu.com\'s business-json key before publishing (SPEC §5 rule 1)');process.exit(1)}console.log('ok: default verifier key pinned')})"
